data_status: DEMO-ONLY SIMULATED DATA; created for this prototype, not part of the official exercise pack
clock: Exercise-local time only; no real event date implied

programme.name: Demo case: a full programme's worth of evidence, not one week

evidence.text: Plan capacity: 24 participants. This is a target, not attendance.
21 unique participants attended at least one session.
No completion assessment has been submitted.
Week 1 kickoff went fine, most of the planned group showed up.
Week 2 coordinator note: two participants dropped out, replaced by walk-ins.
Week 4 update. I think we trained close to twenty-four people by now, but I need to check the sheet.
Week 3 field visit: session ran late, some participants left before the sign-in sheet was passed around.
Week 6 field visit: venue changed on short notice, attendance sheet from that week may be incomplete.
Week 9 field visit: coordinator reported strong engagement, no concerns raised.
Coordinator via SMS, week 5: 'sheet is a bit messy this week, will resend clean copy tomorrow.'
Coordinator via SMS, week 7: 'reminder sent to all participants for next session, expecting good turnout.'
Week 2 session photo log: room shows approximately 20 seated participants, exact count not verifiable from image metadata alone.
Week 8 session photo log: outdoor session, headcount not clearly visible in available images.
Week 1-4 materials budget: 480 USD spent against a planned 500 USD allocation.
Week 5-8 venue costs: 310 USD spent, 40 USD over the planned allocation due to the week 6 venue change.
Independent monitor visit, week 6: session quality rated satisfactory, facilitator preparation noted as strong.
General note from coordinator at week 10: overall pleased with programme progress, planning to request completion assessment window soon.

reviewer_notes.text: This demo case exercises the report builder against a full programme's evidence volume, not a single week. Only the official attendance and plan records carry a numeric claim; every other record is narrative context, exactly as the type-driven exclusion rule requires regardless of volume. This is a demo case, not the official exercise record.

rules: Every numeric claim states unit, period and evidence record.
A draft report stays draft until a reviewer approves it.
No inference about outcomes from participation alone.
